INTRODUCING: The Hire American Act.

This bill does exactly what its title says: hire American workers only. The legislation amends title 5 of the United States Code to restrict federal government employment to U.S. citizens and nationals ONLY.

American taxpayers foot the bill for every single federal job in this country. Every salary. Every benefit. Every pension. Those jobs belong to American workers, not non-citizens. Right now, there is no permanent law stopping a non-citizen from being hir
We want the Death Penalty for anyone who rapes a child.

God Bless our troops. Today, tomorrow, and every single day. 

Without the men and women who put on the uniform, there would be no America. 

Never forget it.

Strong countries need strong leaders. Under President Trump's leadership, America is the most respected country in the world.

America First, always.

South Carolina's justice system is broken. Our state has become a safe haven for pedophiles.

Predators walk free, get slaps on the wrist, and exploit every gap in a system failing to protect the most vulnerable among us.

We will not stop until it is fixed. Until our children are safe. Until justice is actually served.

Video

Women deserve to feel safe in their own private spaces. While the Left pushes to allow men into our spaces, we are taking action.

We introduced the Protecting Women's Private Spaces Act to keep biological males out of women's restrooms, locker rooms, and changing rooms on federal property.

We introduced the Stop the Invasion of Women's Spaces Act to make sure federal dollars do not go to any entity allowing men into women's private spaces.

We introduced a resolution to prohibit Members, offic

America will not be a sanctuary for animal abusers, especially ones who broke into our country illegally in the first place.

We introduced the Illegal Alien Animal Abuser Removal Act of 2026, legislation which makes illegal immigrants convicted of animal cruelty or animal fighting offenses inadmissible to the United States and subject to immediate deportation.

If you come here illegally, you’re already a criminal. Add animal cruelty to the list and you’re on the next flight back. Our bill make

Growing up the daughter of a retired Army General and a retired schoolteacher, I learned early hard work is not optional. It is expected.

My dad taught me service, structure, and a deep love for this country. My mom taught me responsibility, grit, and the importance of showing up no matter what. Between the two of them, cutting corners and making excuses were never on the table.

Those lessons shaped me then. They still drive me now.

I show up for the families of South Carolina every single da

The Left shut down the entire government last year for over a month. Not to protect our borders. Not to invest in our communities. Not to take care of our veterans, our seniors, or our kids.

They shut it down because they wanted to use your hard-earned tax dollars on African bugs and illegal immigrants.

While South Carolina families were stretching every dollar at the grocery store, the Left wanted to spend your money on everything except you.

We will never support wasting your money. Not now

We voted YES on the Protecting Seniors from Emergency Scams Act.

Our seniors deserve to be protected. This bill directs the Federal Trade Commission to report on the number and types of scams targeting older adults and provide real policy recommendations to stop them. It revises the Commission's web portal with up to date information about scams, includes direct contact information for law enforcement and adult protective services agencies, and coordinates with media outlets and law enforcement

Impeach corrupt and activist judges.

If you coddle criminals, refuse to enforce immigration laws, and go soft on crime, you do not deserve to be in charge of justice in this country. The American people are tired of a two tiered justice system. They deserve a system actually working for them, judges who follow the law, and consequences for those who do not.

Judges who refuse to do their job need to be removed.

Video

MACE WIN: We've helped secure more than $5 million in federal funding for law enforcement agencies and first responders across the Lowcountry.

Our officers and first responders put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. It is our job to make sure they have the resources, tools, and funding they need to do it.

We will ALWAYS back the blue and support those who keep us safe.

There is a gap in child safety regulations and children are paying for it with their lives.

We introduced Tyler's Law to close the gap for good. This bill requires hospitals, medical examiner offices, and coroner offices to report incidents involving the death or serious injury of a child, when tied to children's products or durable infant and toddler products, to the Consumer Product Safety Commission within seven days of determination.

No parent should ever suffer the loss of a child because

America's military is the strongest, most lethal fighting force in the world. DEI policies threaten exactly this. 

Every dollar spent on these initiatives is a dollar taken away from readiness, lethality, and the warfighters who earn it. 

We thank Secretary Hegseth for restoring merit and standards back to our military where they belong.

Video

The American people deserve to know exactly who is representing them and where their tax dollars are going. 

We made it our mission to deliver both.
